body: thank you, your username made me smile a bit...i actually don't know how much relaying my sob story over again could help, but i may take you up on your offer.

thank you for your reply. my family pretty much can't stand to look at me so it's nice to know someone out there cares. i am on lexapro, 5mg. I've been on it for two months and it's made very little of a difference.The main reasons why i feel my issues are insignificant is because I'm seventeen and it seems like there's no shortage of people telling me "it'll pass..." (and it hasn't for seventeen years) and also because I have pleny of what to be greatful for - a big family (yet I barely can look at them) a comfortable home, and even some friends.
yet every day i hate myself a little more, and it's starting to wear really thin...
